Fresh var1b re-run on jureca-h100, 4x H100 PCIe 80 GB (case bound to CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0) from the recovered authoritative input (bunch_1mrad_200.h5, sha256 d6f644a3a14457d3b8b37fab52c606f58ac15f832d18089655192b9e03c4634c). Build commit 00fb8f7fb22a53748636c70e32bbdb8dd85c23c4, case harness commit f27d3d3dc020a64ad9ffd2055b0db49f066eb344, binary sha256 717212ed4ad0be862f6b65ab2d2b7d9ace914fda2aeec6a4c8a4f2167e7808e6. The reduced slice reproduces the committed peaks to <=7.1e-16 with identical argmax nodes.
